=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml:359-387 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new unlinked-run clause (`((.pull_requests // []) | length) == 0`, same `head_repository.full_name`, `.created_at >= $pr_created_at`) has no upper bound at the PR's close time. The only exclusion is the cancel workflow itself (lines 384-387). So it also matches sibling runs that the same `pull_request: closed` event starts: AI Issue PR Status (workflow-templates/ai-issue-pr-status.yml:5-6) and, on a merged close, the post-merge AI Review run (workflow-templates/ai-review.yml:18-19/:58, .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:55).
  WHY: Every PR close cancels the Issue PR Status run, which loses label sync and task-lineage finalization. Every merge also cancels the post-merge review run and its `post-merge-validate-dispatch` job (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:869-876). Suggested fix: add `PR_CLOSED_AT` and require `.created_at < $pr_closed_at`. Severity disagreement: sonnet, gemini, minimax (SECURITY item) and glm say BLOCKER; luna and minimax (IMPLICIT-EXECUTION item, which frames the same flaw as a declared-vs-effective capability gap with no whitelist for sibling workflows) say MAJOR. The highest, BLOCKER, is used.
- .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml:359-381 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The unlinked clause never checks `github.event.pull_request.merged`. The trigger (workflow-templates/ai-cancel-on-pr-close.yml:5-6 `types: [closed]`) includes merges. On a merged close, the clause matches and cancels the in-progress review run that performed the merge.
  WHY: Work after `gh pr merge` gets killed: the `review_rb_judge.sh` `merge_with_followup` follow-up issue, "Mark linked issues ready to merge" (review_autofix.yml:5056), and the `ai:review-skipped` / `ai:ready-to-merge` writes (lines 1778-1823). The orchestrator then stalls until stall recovery. A `created_at < closed_at` bound alone does not fix this; a `PR_MERGED` gate is needed. All four reviewers rate it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:449-570 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The only live state read, `review_enable_auto_merge_open_guard pre_merge` at line 449, comes before the post-wait `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` / `_pr_base_sync_inline_merge` (lines 454-456) and `run_security_followup_guard post_wait` (line 475). The script then calls `gh pr merge` at lines 519/570 without re-reading the PR state.
  WHY: The inline merge includes a full `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3079, up to 45 min). A PR closed during that window is still merged, because `--match-head-commit` only binds the head. This repeats the PR #5800 outcome and breaks Goal 1. All three reviewers rate it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1676-1745 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In the deterministic-skip path, the freshness check and the security follow-up guard run after the `pre_merge` state read and before the merge request.
  WHY: A PR closed during these operations still reaches `gh pr merge`, because the head-match option does not stop a closed PR from merging. Both rate it MAJOR. Disagreement: sonnet says the det-skip post-wait freshness (1680/1732) has no inline merge and only an API-call-sized window, so it does not report it separately. glm says the det-skip path is ordered correctly.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:3335-3354 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In `_mt_final_ci_merge_resume`, the `pre_merge` open guard runs after `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` but before `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` and the merge call. That leaves a window in which a close is not caught.
  WHY: A PR closed after the guard and before the merge call is still merged. Both rate it MAJOR. Sonnet notes that the merge-train freshness at review_merge_train.sh:3350 is only a few API calls long and does not report it separately.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3534-3567 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rb_judge merge arm runs the initial freshness check (3534) and the post-wait `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` (3552-3553) before `rb_judge_merge_open_guard` at 3567. That freshness call takes or asks for the merge lease (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2782, 2823) and can push a branch update.
  WHY: A PR closed while the judge waits on checks still takes the lease and/or gets its branch updated before the guard refuses the merge, so Goal 2 is unmet on this path. The merge itself is still blocked. Both rate it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:421-456 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` at lines 422 and 456 calls `_merge_lease_gate`, which can write the lease record (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2782-2809, 2823-2824), before any guard sits at the lease boundary. The guard runs only at `start` (line 366) and `pre_merge` (line 449).
  WHY: A PR closed between the start check and the lease request still takes the lease, gets its branch updated and waits on checks. A closed PR's stale lease can block the next merge.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1662-1725 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The det-skip forward path (1662-1673) and squash path (1714-1725) reach the freshness/lease call before any guard at the lease boundary.
  WHY: A closed PR can still take the lease or update its branch (Goal 2). Disagreement: glm says the det-skip path is ordered correctly.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1581-1592 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The jq projection in `deterministic_skip_head_is_current` reads only `.state/.draft/.head.sha`. Its skip line at line 1588 therefore emits `reason=pr_closed` without `closed_at=<iso>` and reports a merged PR as `pr_closed` instead of `pr_merged`. Both deviate from agents.d/10049-merge-open-pr-guard.md and scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1036-1041.
  WHY: Log consumers parsing `AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED` get a line that does not match the contract, and merged PRs are misclassified. All four rate it NIT. openai_gpt-6-luna raises the same issue as a task gap.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1659-1730 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The deterministic-skip merge path now makes two live `GET pulls/<n>` per merge attempt: `det_skip_merge_open_guard start` at 1659/1711 (no PR JSON passed) and `pre_merge` at 1676/1728. tests/test_pr_merge_state_guard.py `test_det_skip_open_pr_merges_exactly_as_before` asserts 2 `pulls/5800` reads.
  WHY: This exceeds the issue's budget of "at most one REST call per merge attempt" on a high-volume path. Merge safety is unaffected. All five rate it NIT. Sonnet and glm call it a budget tradeoff, because Goal 2 requires a start check.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:322-361 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When the initial `_ORCH_PR_META_JSON` read fails (rate limit, 5xx), the script exits 0 at line 326 without emitting `AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED ... reason=pr_state_unavailable`. It also exits silently at 332-335 (empty head ref) and 358-361 (head SHA mismatch).
  WHY: The script still does not merge, but operators and log analysis cannot tell a clean skip from a transient API blip, and no test covers the initial-read failure. Other reviewers raise the same issue as a task gap.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
